_about: MediaPipe Pose tracks of third-party videos. The videos are not in the repository; video_sha256 identifies the exact file. apparent_sex is an assumption from appearance, used only to pick the ANSUR II sample for body matching.

front_squat_1.notes: screen recording of a trainer's workout video (player controls visible); wide toes-out stance; some motion blur; irregular frame times
front_squat_1.view: front (MediaPipe 3D hips read about 15 deg off square; the image looks square)

front_squat_2.notes: screen recording of a workout video with a rep counter; wide toes-out stance; irregular frame times
front_squat_2.view: front (MediaPipe 3D hips read about 13 deg off square; the image looks square)

front_squat_3.notes: screen recording, reps 102-104 of a high-rep challenge (fast, possibly fatigued); probably the same person as front_squat_1
front_squat_3.view: front with a mild side angle

front_squat_4.notes: screen recording; deep squats; the front-view analysis uses the front-facing part only
front_squat_4.view: front for the first 5.5 s, then the camera orbits to the person's left side (-45 to -90 deg)

front_squat_5.arms: squat press-outs: a 2.5 kg plate held at the chest and pressed forward near the bottom

camera._why: camera position estimated from the framing; toe-out not measurable (feet out of frame), Sinclair 2022 mean used

front_squat_5.notes: the repository owner's own video; toes are below the frame edge so MediaPipe extrapolates the feet
front_squat_5.view: front, phone low near the floor tilted up, portrait

squat_1.notes: trainer demonstration video, continuous reps; the last rep is a 'sit back' squat with vertical shins
squat_1.view: side-on, camera pans and zooms slightly

squat_2.arms: hands clasped in front of the chest
squat_2.notes: trainer demonstration video; starts with a setup bend, then continuous reps
squat_2.view: about 45-50 deg from side-on (front-left), fixed camera
